title: Photon entanglement-enhanced multidimensional spectroscopy of exciton correlations in photosynthetic aggregates
summary: Nonlinear spectroscopic techniques using entangled photon pairs can provide an opportunity to exploit non-classical correlations encoded in two-photon wavefunctions to manipulate two-exciton wavefunctions. We propose an entangled photon pair-enhanced multidimensional spectroscopic technique that is sensitive to exciton-exciton interactions and correlations at the femtosecond timescale.
